name: Game mode, full start, mic monitor muted (VM trace xfi_20261030_013442)
post_writes_note: DAC-path gains 0x072/0x073: this start writes only their PCURR (1.0) -> PMOP 0, PSR 0, PTRAG = PCURR = 1.0 so Linux leftovers cannot ramp them. Mic monitor = parameter slots 0x0ae/0x0af (muted in this start; switch = Windows' bursts #4 on / #8 off). Windows volume was 100% (0x00e/0x00f target 1.0).
controls_note: Crystalizer Level = the 17 coefficients 0x1db8-0x1df8 per slider step (burst #10 end = min, #11 min->max); Bass Boost = bursts #14 on / #19 off (level/cutoff at Windows' defaults); EQ = #24 off / #20 on (console's preset) / #21 (the one preset change); EQ Level = parameter 0x1f4 target, steps of #23 (min->max, -22..+1.6 dB). Bass Boost: on = bursts #14+#15+#16 (on, level min->max->middle = Windows' middle level, cutoff at minimum); Cutoff slider = the 40 steps of #17 (min->max at the middle level; crossover lowpass ~6..100 Hz). Level slider needs Creative's filter formula (not RBJ; to do). Cutoff slider REMOVED (user: changes the sound but not the bass, works with Bass Boost off - the steps carry the whole filter chain incl. what looks like the 2.1 crossover lowpass). Bass Boost switch REMOVED too (no audible bass at the minimum cutoff, only a short dropout). Master volume = Windows' volume slider (burst #28): parameter slots 0x0e,0x0f,0x12,0x13,0x16,0x17,0x1a,0x1b,0x1e,0x1f,0x22,0x23,0x26,0x27 (targets 1.0, 0x17/0x27 0.5; PSR 0x368/0x1b4) AFTER the effects + DSP float 0x10141c = 0.1/volume (Windows tells the effects the volume; 0.1 at 100%). Slider -50..0 dB in 0.5 dB steps. Master volume v2: per slot PTRAG=new, PSR=0, PCURR=new (Windows freezes a slot this way before a ramp; v1 with PTRAG+PSR only did nothing). Mic Capture Volume = Windows' recording input level (trace xfi_20261030_034206 bursts #7/#8): parameter slots 0x42/0x43 (game4 start 0.5 = Windows 51; 100 = ~2.0), steps of the 0->100 sweep, written PTRAG=x, PSR=0, PCURR=x.

capture.note:
ADC rings 0x144/0x146 -> ops 0x480/0x490 -> converter 76, 0x149/0x14e -> ops 0x4a0/0x4b0 -> converter 77 (rate
  conversion, F32) -> rings 0x4c1/0x4d1 -> ops 0x4c0-0x4f0 -> converter 75 (WR=1 = writes memory, S32, input map
  entries 88-91) -> loop 0x1b55000..0x1b56e00 (transport map entry 74).
  The trace's state before the burst (Windows start + playback on converter 202) is identical to game4 + our
  playback in mixer, converters and input maps, so the burst is replayed verbatim; only the map entry's page address
  becomes ours (devlo/devhi of 0x1b55000 = ct_dsp_fx.c WIN_REC_VA).
  (First try, 2026-10-30: the recording-only trace xfi_20261030_034206 used converter 202 + the playback buffer;
  moved to 205 + 0x1b7b000 it wrote the mic into DSP memory -> distortion.)
